g.text: 32 new scenes per noise family; continuously randomized 20–40 kHz carriers and target angles. Tones: peak amplitude 0.008; pulses: 0.04, envelope σ=85 μs, random arrival time.
Thresholds use 64 separate noise-only calibration frames at a nominal 5% false-alarm target. Bars include localization within 3.01°. Error bars: descriptive Wilson intervals.
Measured false-alarm rates are in the tables; small differences are uncertain. Synthetic amplitudes are not SPL or field detection probability.
